run_hunyuan_video_framepack_pipeline: run the HunyuanVideoFramepackPipeline to generate video from a single input image and text prompt
run_first_last_image_to_video: run the pipeline to generate a video transition between a first image and a last image using inverted anti-drifting sampling
encode_text_prompts_with_llama_and_clip: encode text prompts using Llama and CLIP text encoders to produce prompt embeddings and attention masks
encode_input_images_for_video_generation: encode input images into image embeddings using the Siglip vision model for conditioning the video generation
prepare_video_latents_with_framepack_sam: prepare latent variables for video generation using framepack windowed sampling with history blending
